methodology: Gzip delta of fixtures/consumer-app's built JS+CSS (dist/assets/*.{js,css}), per scenario: "basic" is index.html and App.vue, "grid" is grid.html and GridApp.vue, a data grid with a modal, a slideover and toasts (#377). Each is the build with @itguy614/clean-ui imported minus the same build with clean-ui swapped for a same-shaped stub (CUI_BUNDLE_BASELINE=1). See scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs. This file is read, never auto-written, by CI — re-measure and update gzipBytes/measured by hand when a size increase is expected and accepted.
